summary: The study examines the electronic structure of crystalline and amorphous ZnSnO3 thin films using ab-initio calculations and experimental results from atomic layer deposition (ALD). The material is deposited using Zn, Sn, and O precursors at 150 °C. The electronic properties are analyzed through O K-edge X-ray absorption spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and thin-film transistors. The conduction band minimum is mainly composed of Sn 5s states, with differences in localization between crystalline and amorphous phases.
evidence: In order to examine the disorder effects in ZTO experimentally, two 60-nm-thick ZTO thin films were prepared by ALD using C4H10Zn, C12H28N2O2Sn, and O3 as the precursors for Zn, Sn, and O, respectively, on a Si wafer at 150 °C.
